name: Oskar Pajka
profile: I make independent concept launch films for software products in After Effects, rebuilding each interface and animating every shot, sound included. I also build software in TypeScript and React, currently framecatch, a screenshot and recording tool for Windows. Open to freelance film work and part-time internships alongside school.
